info.title: Know Phase 2 API — review draft
info.description: Documentation proposal only. Phase 1 implemented API and migrations are unchanged. Product policies are approved; technical routes/payloads are for review. See each operation description and the history-correction review note.

get.description:
type required: BOOK | MOVIE | TV_SHOW | GAME. query/status/completionYear optional. status must belong to selected type. limit initially default 20/max 100, both configurable in application.yml. Cursor: createdAt + UUID, newest first. Bind cursor to type/search/status/year and always scope by owner. query is case-insensitive literal title substring; it does not alter exact-title identity.

One item per entity. completionYear filters by history events inside the UTC year, irrespective of current status. completionCount is for selected year, otherwise all history. totalCompletionCount and lastCompletedAt always cover all history. Without a year, include unfinished entities. No article HTML in summaries.

Technical contract draft for review. Approved product policies are preserved; exact routes, payloads and the noted technical choices require review before implementation. Approved: case-insensitive literal title substring search; exact-title duplicate identity is unchanged.

post.description:
type/title required; status optional, defaults TO_READ / TO_BE_SEEN / TO_PLAY. Optional completedAt only when initial status is completed; omitted timestamp means server-now. Titles must be nonblank, exact unmodified text, configurable maximum 1,000 Unicode code points. No caller account, ID or createdAt.

201 + Location. Exact owner/type/title duplicate returns 409 DUPLICATE_ENTITY, never silently reuses a manual creation. Case and spaces are significant. Initial completed status creates the first completion atomically. Exact-title hash uniqueness handles concurrent requests and long titles; compare full titles on conflict.

Technical contract draft for review. Approved product policies are preserved; exact routes, payloads and the noted technical choices require review before implementation. Approved initial statuses: BOOK=TO_READ, MOVIE/TV_SHOW=TO_BE_SEEN, GAME=TO_PLAY.

patch.description:
version required; title and/or status required. Optional completedAt only for an actual transition into completed status. Omitted fields unchanged; null/blank title rejected. Entity type and createdAt immutable in this draft.

200. Real transition into READ/SEEN/FINISHED appends an event using supplied time or server-now, atomically. Repeating the same completed status does not append history; use Add completion. Actual title/status/history changes increment entity version; no-op does not. Rename into exact owner/type/title duplicate returns 409 without partial changes. Leaving completed status preserves history. Metadata edits on linked articles never implicitly rename or replace this entity.

201 if a new entity is created, 200 if an exact owner/type/title entity is reused. Reuse existing entity/status/history, then ensure association exists atomically.
